liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): Jerry recalled lyrics almost perfectly and enunciated the words clearly [12]
- **Queen Jane Approximately** (1 other source): Bob Weir played acoustic guitar for this specific song [1]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 other source): Features a two-minute intro to the song [8]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 other source): This is the longest version of the song recorded for this date [8]
- **I Fought The Law** (1 review): Reviewer criticized the song as a cop-out for the encore slot [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **Childhood's End**: rare: 13 archived performances [22]
- **Samba On The Rain**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]
- **Sunshine Daydream, Encore Break**: back after 121 archived shows (504 days); rare: 13 archived performances [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-07-26.AKG451.Darbys2nd.120292.Flac2448** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 176 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Excellent recording quality allows the listener to be blown away by the band [20]
- **gd94-07-26.smith.ladner.10225.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 178 min; rated 3.25/5 by 12 [2]. Said about its sound: Both Riverport audience recordings sound great, possibly due to matrixes [15]
- **gd1994-07-26.139978.s2.sbd.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 12 songs; 106 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [8]
- **gd1994-07-26.AKG451.Darby.119446.Flac1644**: audience recording; 22 songs; 183 min [3]

## Around the show

- A Nebraska bar owner behind the reviewer was thrilled by the song's start [10]
- The date marks the fourth anniversary of Brent Mydland's death [12]
- Listener discovered Brent Mydland died on their birthday, causing emotional reaction [13]
- Smallest Midwest outdoor venue offered a nice change from Soldier Field [16]
- Local crowd was unfriendly, and band members were rude to attendees [19]
- St. Louis native felt the local crowd was welcoming to out-of-towners [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-07-26.AKG451.Darbys2nd.120292.Flac2448**: taped by Mike Darby; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby; AKG451EB/CK1's (DIN/DFC/First 1/4 Of OTS/9 Feet High)> AKGBP18s>Sony TC-D5M,Tapes Maxell MX; Transfer Information:Tascam… [1]
- **gd94-07-26.smith.ladner.10225.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Chase Smith; transferred by Paul; source: Audience: Shure BG-40's [2]. Also: Chase used Shure BetaGreen 4.0 cardioid condenser microphones for the recording; Chase Smith recorded with Shure BG-40s into Sony D-7 DAT [2][17]
- **gd1994-07-26.139978.s2.sbd.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Dat (Panasonic SV-3700/44.1k) [8]. Also: First soundboard for this date, cloned from the vault master by David Gans [8]
- **gd1994-07-26.AKG451.Darby.119446.Flac1644**: taped by Mike Darby; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby; AKG451EB/CK1's (DIN/DFC/First 1/4 Of OTS/9 Feet High)> Whirlwind Phantoms>Teac DA-P20 @ 16/48; Transfer Information:Sony… [3]
